title: AI Surrogate Modeling for Real-Time Tokamak Equilibrium Prediction: Benchmarking Neural Architectures and Validation on EXL-50U
abstract: arXiv:2608.23217v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fast and reliable plasma equilibrium prediction is essential for real-time tokamak operation and control, but conventional Grad-Shafranov (GS) solvers are often too costly for real-time deployment. We develop an AI surrogate framework and benchmark five architectures (MLP, CNN, FNO, Transformer, and KAN) on a numerical GS database with 100,000 IID and 10,000 OOD samples. Under a unified protocol, we evaluate accuracy, inference efficiency, model scaling, and robustness. We also establish device-level validation on the EXL-50U tokamak by linking numerical GS solutions, surrogate predictions, and the standard Shape Editor reference to assess simulation-to-device consistency. The surrogates achieve errors of $10^{-3}$-$10^{-2}$ relative to GS solutions, while the GS-to-device discrepancy remains at $10^{-3}$. Transformer gives the best IID accuracy, whereas CNN offers the best balance of accuracy, robustness, and speed, reaching 0.7 ms Te

translated_title: 面向实时托卡马克平衡预测的AI替代模型：神经架构基准测试及在EXL-50U上的验证
translated_abstract: 快速可靠的等离子体平衡预测对于实时托卡马克运行和控制至关重要，但传统的Grad-Shafranov (GS)求解器往往因计算成本过高而难以满足实时部署需求。我们开发了一个AI替代模型框架，并在包含100,000个独立同分布(IID)和10,000个分布外(OOD)样本的数值GS数据库上，对五种架构（MLP、CNN、FNO、Transformer和KAN）进行了基准测试。在统一协议下，我们评估了准确性、推理效率、模型扩展性和鲁棒性。我们还通过在EXL-50U托卡马克上建立设备级验证，将数值GS解、替代模型预测和标准Shape Editor参考联系起来，以评估仿真到设备的连贯性。替代模型相对于GS解的误差在$10^{-3}$-$10^{-2}$范围内，而GS到设备的差异保持在$10^{-3}$。Transformer在IID准确性上表现最佳，而CNN在准确性、鲁棒性和速度之间提供了最佳平衡，推理时间达到0.7毫秒。
tldr: 本研究开发并基准测试了五种AI替代模型用于实时托卡马克平衡预测，其中CNN在准确性、鲁棒性和速度（0.7毫秒）上达到最佳平衡，并在EXL-50U上完成了设备级验证。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks five AI surrogate architectures for real-time tokamak equilibrium prediction, finding CNN achieves the best balance of accuracy, robustness, and speed (0.7 ms), with device-level validation on EXL-50U.
